title: Small-bias generator multiset
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\ell$ be a nonzero natural number. Take every ordered pair $(r,s)$ of elements of the binary extension field of degree $\ell$, apply the small-bias generator to each pair, and retain the resulting outputs as a multiset, including repetitions.
caveat: The encoding and generator operations are not defined in the supplied descriptions, so the output vectors are only identified by reference to the separately described generator.
